_status: Calibrated 2026-10-10 on 9 iPhone before/after pairs (evals/shoot-1, tools/calibrate.py). Base = median of 8 pairs (02 excluded as a different style). Leave-one-out error 0.029 vs 0.070 unedited.
_description: The author's signature: mid-tones pulled down with brightness while lights stay bright, a little warmer, colour slightly richer. No grain, vignette, or colour wash.

night._when: Night/indoor lit by lamps, candles, LED strips; also most landscapes and general scenes. Same as the base.
night._from: pairs 01, 03, 06, 09 (close fits); 07 and 10 also near it

lit-subject-in-dark._when: A lit subject (person, outfit, watches) surrounded by near-black. Keeps texture in the subject.

daylight._when: Bright, open daytime (input mids above ~0.38): street, cars, architecture, sunlit mountains. Normalises exposure toward mids ~0.35 instead of a fixed darkening. NOT for dark subjects that HDR brightened (open water, dark hills, dark interior with a bright window): those stay on night. Dim or overcast daytime also stays on night.
daylight._from: pairs 04, 07, 10 (09 overcast checked unharmed); error vs the author's edits 0.020, old fixed -0.55 EV version 0.070

cool-muted._when: OPT-IN ONLY: the user asks for a cold, washed-out look. Not for landscapes in general (tested on 3 landscapes: wrong).

quiet-luxury._when: OPT-IN ONLY, and only when the subject suits it: classic/old stone architecture, vintage cars, candlelit or wood interiors, autumn streets, muted natural materials. Not for modern glass and steel, coloured lighting, strong single-colour subjects or blue-hour skies (reads as a filter). Whole frame toned warm, cool colours muted, no pure whites, exposure normalised dark.
quiet-luxury._from: 8 online reference photos (evals/online-refs), measured not fitted; not the author's own edits
